_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: a 3DO project is one or more disc images. The BIOS comes through the firmware page, driven by the systemType setting.

slots.title: Discs
slots.help: 3DO disc images: .iso/.bin raw dumps, a .cue sheet whose referenced track files join the project automatically, or a .chd. The first disc is in the drive at boot; the order here is the swap order used by the Previous/Next Disc inputs.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the console starts with already remembered. A 3DO keeps saved games and its own settings in NVRAM; this is the file Emulator > Export Save Data... writes, put back under the same name - NVRAM.ram - so a run can continue from where another left off. It is mounted read-only and pinned by hash, and the movie cites it, so a movie that starts from a saved game is as reproducible as one that starts from a blank console. Leave it empty and the machine starts with nothing remembered.
